text: Binary per-row measure from the `argument` column (OP's own text only, current supplied text including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, discloses personal emotional vulnerability about themselves (own fear, shame, insecurity, sadness, distress, loneliness, emotional pain or struggle); otherwise 0. Does not count: purely intellectual, factual or general statements, other people's feelings, hypothetical or invented persons, quotations of others not adopted by the OP, or mere anger/opinion without self-exposing vulnerability. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if emotionally vulnerable); generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be kept if relevant. Do not reconstruct the original post. Missing or malformed argument returns null; assessable text with no qualifying disclosure returns 0.
